help:
usage: gnd evolve apply [-h] --preview PREVIEW --workspace WORKSPACE
                        --records RECORDS [--format {text,json}]
                        model proposal

Require PROPOSAL and PREVIEW to reproduce the current exact preview, obtain
the exact blast-radius digest for a breaking proposal, publish the candidate
model CAS and durable pending-finalization evidence, then complete the
verbalization, live linked-project conformance, and final record in the same
invocation. The exit is the raw aggregate conformance exit, so linked drift
returns 13 with the model published and no rollback.

positional arguments:
  model                 current model file beneath ROOT
  proposal              closed evolution proposal JSON beneath ROOT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --preview PREVIEW     exact reviewed PREVIEW JSON beneath ROOT
  --workspace WORKSPACE
                        authoritative existing workspace ROOT
  --records RECORDS     authoritative immutable evidence DIR
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload
